title: Email transit validation and invite delivery tracing for org/team onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add email transit validation, per-invite delivery tracing, and allowlist/denylist reconciliation hooks to the org/team invite subsystem. Motivation: observed gaps where invites are marked delivered but never accepted (no bounce/SMTP metadata was captured), and SAML tenant onboarding struggles to reconcile domain claims with external MX/SPF/DKIM issues. This ticket implements SMTP response capture, DKIM/SPF check metadata, and a compact invite-delivery-trace record that ties to audit logs and RBAC v2 enforcement points. The feature will be used by console admins, SRE, and security reviewers to debug onboarding failures and to drive automated remediation (e.g., surface domain verification steps to end users).
acceptance_criteria: Invite objects include a compact delivery_trace id when an outbound invite email is sent
SMTP transaction metadata (status code, bounce reason, relay path) persisted for 30 days and surfaced in audit logs
DKIM/SPF/DMARC preliminary check results captured at send time and exposed in the Console invite details view
Reconciliation job that backfills discrepancies between domain allowlist/denylist and recent invite outcomes runs without impacting send throughput
New RBAC checks prevent non-admins from viewing full SMTP headers; only 'org.security' and 'support' roles may view sensitive fields
E2E tests and a canary rollout plan verified against staging with synthetic bounce scenarios
implementation_steps: Design: finalize delivery_trace schema (id, timestamp, smtp_status, smtp_code, bounce_reason, spf_result, dkim_result, relay_chain) - keep fields minimal to reduce storage
Backend: instrument invite sender service to emit delivery_trace to events topic and persist a 1KB summary on the invite row
Audit: extend audit logging to reference delivery_trace id and capture a redacted copy of smtp_status for non-privileged viewers
DB: migration to add invite.delivery_trace_id and delivery_trace_summary (text) - rollout zero-downtime with phased writes
Reconciliation: implement a periodic job that compares tenant domain allowlist/denylist with DNS/SPF/DKIM results and flags anomalies
Console: add invite details panel with role-based rendering of delivery status and a link to the redacted trace; add a 'request resend' action that includes guidance
Testing: create synthetic SMTP bounce harness in staging and add integration tests covering RBAC-limited visibility
Rollout: canary to 5% orgs, monitor invite success rate, observability dashboard, and error budget impact before full release
